paper_title: Strongly Monotone Drawings of Planar Graphs
statement: We have shown that any 3-connected planar graph, tree, outerplanar graph, and 2-tree admits a strongly monotone drawing. All our drawings require exponential area. For trees, this area bound has been proven to be required; however, it remains open whether the other graph classes can be drawn in polynomial area. Further, the question whether any 2-connected planar graph admits a strongly monotone drawing remains open. Last but not least, we could observe (using a computer-assisted search) that 2-connected graphs with at most 9 vertices admit a strongly monotone drawing, while there is exactly one connected graph with 7 vertices that is the smallest graph not admitting a strongly monotone drawing; see Figure 10.
